source_medium_qualification: Photographed page is a facsimile in Franko's modern book, showing typography and decorative woodcut; author/editor calls early print. The original historical exemplar is not directly inspected.
photographic_notes: Original print source SHA and user photographic SHA hashes refer to distinct images of the same reproduced page. The user's camera closeups are not geometrically registered to the original 1190×1701 JPEG; the boxes stored below are from the pinned prior JPEG, not invented camera-pixel boxes.

Seven photos overlap, and all show the same two-column page. Do not treat them as independent textual witnesses, multiple reader votes, or an improvement to the bibliographic provenance of the original early print.
Photographs include a horizontal page fold/shadow and perspective distortions. Titla, ligatures and superscript letters must be inspected at native resolution before certifying any Unicode grapheme.

Observed readings are cautious lexical anchors. Diacritics are editorial placeholders wherever exact print signs have not been independently identified. Never directly copy observed_reading_or_anchor to a TEI glyph node.
